text:
frank: Heads-up: planning v2 cutover in ~1h. DeployBot scheduled at 10:30 UTC. Please freeze any client schema changes and hold noncritical mobile SDK merges.

carla: noted. Any integration owners with pending migrations? @alice @ben

alice: mobile SDK team — we have a small schema change queued but can hold it. ETA to revert if needed ~15m.

ben: running final e2e now. one flaky test on reranking service, investigating.

frank: what are we seeing on reranker?

ben: quick snippet from logs: ```ERROR: reranker timeout 504 for /v2/rerank``` occasional 503s too. looks like warmup or connection pool pressure.

carla: if reranker flaps, plan is to pin traffic to v1 for hosts showing >2% 5xx over 5m. can we apply a quick adaptive rollout policy?

DeployBot: config applied: rollout_policy=v2_adaptive_threshold; fallback_route=api-v1; monitor=svc-5xx>2%:action=shift_to_v1

frank: thanks. ops — keep an eye on the canary (10%) for the first 10m, then ramp to 30% if stable.

eva: adding release-notes tag: "v2: stricter embeddings input schema; optional param 'prompt_meta' added". pinging docs for notes.

carla: also adding deploy window + rollback checklist to the release notes.

ben: e2e green locally after bumping connection pool. will push hotfix before canary if needed.

DeployBot: [SCHEDULED] 10:30 UTC: Start canary 10% -> target 100% over 40m; watchlist: reranker, gateway, mobile-proxy

frank: if any client pins surface, escalate to #support and we'll hold the rollout.

alice: mobile SDK — creating hotfix branch to drop the queued schema change. will open PR in ~10m.

dave: ops: I'll run synthetic probes across regions when canary starts and post results here.

DeployBot: [ALERT] Canary at 10% completed. Metrics: 5xx=0.6% (baseline 0.4%), p50 latency +3ms. no fallback triggered.

dave: probes look ok in us-west/eu, slight spike in ap-southeast (latency +40ms) — investigating path.

frank: hold the ramp. dave follow-up and report within 5m. carla mark patch hold until apac clears.

carla: marked in DeployBot: ramp_paused_by=carla; note=apac latency spike

DeployBot: ramp paused. current traffic v2=10%. next action=manual_resume

dave: apac network team found transient GCP egress flap; resolved now. probes back to baseline.

dave: apac latency normalized; no 5xx. recommend resume.

frank: resuming ramp to 30% now.

DeployBot: resuming ramp. 30% target achieved. metrics steady. no rollback triggered.

ben: reranker metrics stable after the pool tweak. pushing minor config hotfix to prod.

alice: removed schema-change PR; mobile SDK pinned to v1 for flagged customers.

eva: release notes updated in docs repo, will publish after full rollout.

frank: thanks all — leaving this thread open for 1h after full rollout. if anything pops, revert to v1 and follow the rollback checklist.
